# Scope

One constructed CircuitBreaker and its TwoStepCircuitBreaker façade. Model admission, synchronous request execution, caller-held completion callbacks, configuration policies, generation and counter lifetime, lazy time reconciliation and state observation. Actors are the settings provider, request caller, completion reporter, observer, injected request and policy callbacks, and the runtime clock. The protected service owns network, retry, cancellation and teardown; no neighbouring analysis was supplied. The illustrative HTTP client is outside the breaker. Shared-resource probes assume independent breaker instances and callers using the same downstream service. The model projects constructed breaker modes and tracks in-flight work and mutex ownership separately. Questions on zero-value objects and copying mark public-boundary concerns.
